Simply supported beam spans.provides: loss of one span only, redundancy between spans

Continuous multi-span girder.requires: a deck continuous over several supports
Continuous multi-span girder.provides: load redistribution when one support moves, progressive collapse risk

Fracture-critical truss.requires: a member whose failure collapses the structure

Arch on masonry piers.provides: very high durability, dependence on the piers remaining founded

Routine visual inspection.requires: an inspector with access to the surfaces
Routine visual inspection.provides: detection of visible deterioration, nothing below water or inside a member

Underwater pier survey.requires: divers or sonar at the foundations
Underwater pier survey.provides: condition of the foundation, nothing about the deck

Structural health monitoring.requires: installed sensors and a data link
Structural health monitoring.provides: continuous response data, detection of change rather than cause

No inspection since construction.requires: an asset absent from any register

Detected and repaired.requires: the defect found before capacity is lost

Load restriction imposed.provides: economic and diversion cost, structure retained

Partial collapse.requires: loss of one element with the structure standing
